title: Shell panel layout consistency: Sidebar, ChatSidebar, AppHeader, AppContextFooter
description: Apply layout consistency pass to the four shell components. Unify icon button sizing (h-8 w-8 for regular, h-7 w-7 for compact), divider styling (border-gray-200 dark:border-dark-border), and active-item highlight (bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/20 text-primary-700 dark:text-primary-300) across all four files.
action: In Sidebar.tsx, ChatSidebar.tsx, AppHeader.tsx, AppContextFooter.tsx: (1) standardize icon-only button className to 'flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-colors' with consistent hover/active/focus-visible ring; (2) replace any one-off divider heights/colors with 'border-t border-gray-200 dark:border-dark-border'; (3) normalize active conversation/item highlight to 'bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/20'; (4) ensure all interactive elements have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50.

convergence.definition_of_done: All four shell components use consistent icon-button sizing, divider styling, active highlight color, and focus-visible rings. No panel-specific rogue overrides remain.

files.target: icon buttons, dividers, active item highlight
files.change: Normalize to standard icon button + focus-visible pattern

files.target: icon buttons, dividers, active item highlight

implementation: Step 1 — Read each file. List all <button> elements that are icon-only (no text label visible). Check their current h-/w- classes.

Step 2 — Normalize icon buttons to: 'flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-gray-500 dark:text-dark-text-secondary transition-colors hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-dark-surface hover:text-gray-700 dark:hover:text-dark-text focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50'.
Step 3 — Find all horizontal/vertical divider elements. Replace one-off colors with 'border-gray-200 dark:border-dark-border'.
Step 4 — In Sidebar.tsx and ChatSidebar.tsx, find the active conversation/item highlight. Replace with 'bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/20 text-primary-700 dark:text-primary-300'.

success_metrics: Sidebar.test.tsx, ChatSidebar.test.tsx, AppHeader.test.tsx, AppContextFooter.test.tsx all pass

reference.pattern: ChatAreaComposer toolbar icon buttons (h-7 w-7 rounded-lg) as the compact reference; AppMainContent buttons for h-8 w-8 standard size.

rationale.chosen_approach: In-place Tailwind class normalization — no new abstractions. Audit + replace.
